vat_id.title: VAT number
vat_id.description: One EU VAT number with its country prefix, e.g. NL123456789B01, DE123456789 or FR40303265045. Spaces, dots and dashes are ignored; GR is read as EL. Leave empty when you use 'VAT numbers (batch)'.

expected_name.title: Expected company name (optional)
expected_name.description: For a single VAT number: the name you expect. The output's name_match is 1.0 when the VIES name is the same company (legal forms and punctuation ignored), lower when it differs. Only works for countries where VIES returns a name.

vat_ids.title: VAT numbers (batch)
vat_ids.description: Up to 200 VAT numbers per run: a list of strings, or of objects {"vat_id": ..., "expected_name": ...}. Clear the single 'VAT number' field when you use this.
